q: membranous layer of superficial perineal fascia
not_shipped.name: Colles' fascia
not_shipped.why: This project cites it -- data/anatomy/structure_parts.json carries the `colles_fascia` part set and its pockets, from Martin BF, J Anat 1984 -- but no page ships a Colles' fascia MESH. Q297 removed the one generated perineal surface and left the region open; no source this project holds contains female perineal fascia.

q: membranous layer of subcutaneous abdominal tissue
membranous layer of the subcutaneous tissue of the abdomen
not_shipped.name: Scarpa's fascia
not_shipped.canon: Membranous layer of the subcutaneous tissue of the abdomen
not_shipped.why: Cited by data/anatomy/structure_parts.json (the Scarpa sac and its three pockets, Martin BF, J Anat 1984). No page ships it as a mesh: the abdominal wall on these pages carries `Investing abdominal fascia` and the subcutaneous fat, not a separate membranous layer.

not_shipped.name: Gerdy's tubercle
not_shipped.why: A bone LANDMARK, not a structure: this project cites it as the distal attachment of the iliotibial tract (data/anatomy/structure_parts.json, 'via iliotibial tract to Gerdy's tubercle'). No page ships a mesh for a tubercle, so the search offers the iliotibial tract and the tibia and says which one carries the landmark.

q: cooper s ligament of the pelvis
not_shipped.name: Pectineal ligament (Cooper)
not_shipped.why: data/derived/Q248_ligament_audit.md lists it on all six pages' MISSING list with 'no source'; it is not shipped. The other Cooper eponym -- the suspensory ligaments of the breast -- IS shipped on the three female pages.
